name: ui-ux-multistack
description: Design, review, and implement application UI across native macOS (SwiftUI, AppKit), web (HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue, Tailwind), and hybrid desktop apps that embed web views (WKWebView, Electron, Tauri, Code-OSS forks). Detects the real UI technology of each surface first, then runs an adaptive design workflow: discovery, analysis, direction, wireframes, design spec, build, rendered verification, refinement. Use when asked to "design a screen", "redesign this app", "improve the UI/UX", "build a component", "create a design system", "review this screenshot", "fix visual inconsistencies", "make this look native", or "evaluate usability". Do NOT use for SwiftUI state and architecture (see swiftui-patterns), Liquid Glass API details (see liquid-glass-design), a pure accessibility audit (see accessibility), or a one-line style tweak that needs no design judgment.
